manual.title: Enter a Learning ID
manual.description:
Paste the Learning ID for your native remote. This supports both legacy and extended remotes.

You can copy an ID from an existing Proflame2 fireplace in Home Assistant or generate one using the companion Learning ID helper. See [Using Learning IDs]({learning_ids_url}) for instructions.

Save the ID for future use: it describes the specific native remote used to generate it.

For legacy remotes with known Remote ID & C/D Values, choose Enter legacy values from the Proflame 2 Fireplace - Add entry option.

learn.title: Learn fireplace profile
learn.description: Choose the controller type to use for guided learning. After this step, listening starts automatically. The fireplace does not need to start in any specific state. The integration will guide you through a small sequence of button presses so it can confirm one stable remote profile.

yardstick_band.title: Choose YardStick RF band
yardstick_band.description:
315 MHz is the default for most users. Choose 433 MHz only if your original remote uses 433 or 433.92 MHz.

Check the remote's identification label on the back or inside the battery cover. If the frequency is not printed, use the model/part number on that label to check the remote or fireplace manual's radio-frequency specification. Do not infer the frequency from digits in an FCC ID.

Learning starts after you submit this choice. You can change it later in the fireplace device's Configuration section. One controller supports one fireplace.

optional_settings.title: Optional settings (2 of 2)
optional_settings.description: Choose optional behavior, then submit to save both pages. Leave flame OFF support disabled unless your original remote supports it.

data.allow_flame_off_when_on: Allow flame OFF while power is ON

data_description.refresh_period_minutes: Resend the current ON state after this many minutes without a transmission or valid received command. Set to 0 to disable. No refresh is sent while the fireplace is OFF.
data_description.allow_flame_off_when_on: Enable only if your original remote can turn the flame off while keeping the fireplace ON for lights or fan operation. Otherwise, leave this off.
data_description.active_listening: Update Home Assistant when you use the original remote by keeping the radio in listening mode when not transmitting.
data_description.debug_logging: Record detailed diagnostic information for troubleshooting. Leave this off unless requested for support.

progress.learn_remote:
Listening with {backend_name}.

{instruction}

Complete the requested action within 2 minutes. Repeated packets do not extend the timeout. Close this dialog to cancel listening.
